serialization: camelCase; all documented nullable fields are present

query.category: optional category ID (one in-scope Google Skills learning path)

errors.409: cursor belongs to a different snapshot

Resource.id: ga_ plus first 24 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256 of canonical URL
Resource.title: official title
Resource.url: canonical https://www.skills.google public learning path, course, or lab (?parent=catalog) page
categoryIds: IDs of in-scope Google Skills learning paths whose pages list this resource (<slug>-<path_id>)
tags: credential label shown on the listing or course page, such as Skill badge

duration.courseMinutes: estimated minutes shown on the page (courses and labs) or null
duration.pathMinutes: estimated minutes shown on the listing for learning paths or null

units.title: official lesson, quiz, lab, or path member title
units.url: official course unit URL, or the member resource URL

sourceUrls: the resource page, then https://www.skills.google/catalog when present in the listing, then the learning path pages that list it

Resource.artwork: always null (Google Skills serves one generic share image for every page)

MediaReference.note: Reserved for contract compatibility. Resources never carry media.

Category.id: slug of learning path title + '-' + path number
Category.label: learning path title from its public page

Coverage.discovered: expected count including the path and its non-deprecated members, or null when the path page was not read

snapshotBehavior: Public requests only read a validated local snapshot. They never crawl or fetch source pages. Failed refresh keeps the last valid snapshot. Age greater than 7 days reports stale by default.
artworkBehavior: Google Skills serves a single generic share image across pages, so artwork is always null in this service and rejected if non-null.

conditionalRequests.validator: Weak ETag of the complete normalized JSON representation; If-None-Match supports weak/strong equivalents, lists and *.
conditionalRequests.notModified: 304, empty body, same ETag/cache policy; request validation and cursor checks run first.
conditionalRequests.uncached: All HTTP errors, /health* and a /v1/status whose state is unavailable use no-store and no ETag.
conditionalRequests.cors: If-None-Match request header permitted; ETag response header exposed; origin * without credentials.
conditionalRequests.edgeKey: Full query string; only successful public GET catalog and status responses. No error caching.
conditionalRequests.frontend: Catalog HTML public, max-age=3600; hashed /assets/ bundles public, max-age=31536000, immutable; other static files public, max-age=86400.
conditionalRequests.publication: Changed representation changes ETag. The collector purges the deployment hostname from the edge cache after each publication; without a purge, shared caches may serve the previous representation, including a time-derived status state, for up to a day. Browsers may reuse a catalog response for a day, and for up to seven more days while revalidating or when the origin fails; clients that need the latest snapshot compare snapshotId from /v1/status, which browsers recheck after five minutes. A stale cursor can return 409 and must restart with unchanged filters.

audienceNote: Accepted for compatibility with the OpenAI Academy API. Google Skills pages publish no audience, so audiences is always [].
levelNote: Google Skills maps introductory, intermediate, and advanced levels to beginner, intermediate, and advanced (else null).
collection: Deterministic, operator-run collector: robots.txt is parsed first and checked for every URL; catalog listing pages (/catalog?page=1..) discover entries; entries matching standalone word 'gemini' (excluding [DEPRECATED] titles) and members of in-scope learning paths are selected; learning paths and courses are fetched sequentially (GET only, >= 1.1s apart); lab pages are never fetched. A path or course page that fails keeps its last record; an entry that leaves scope leaves the snapshot. No model or agent is involved.
